response.sql: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_rel_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS area_vol_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), with_avg AS (SELECT *, AVG(area_vol_ratio) OVER () AS avg_ratio FROM per_source) SELECT fundflux, avg_rel_diff, area_vol_ratio, area_vol_ratio - avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM with_avg WHERE area_vol_ratio > avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A funding source's area-to-volume ratio is SUM(aream2)/SUM(volm3), using only records where both values are present. This is a ratio of totals, not an average of per-record ratios.
The 'simple average' is the unweighted mean of the per-funding-source ratios, with each funding source counted once.
Records with boxx of 0 or NULL are left out of the relative-difference average, and a funding source with a NULL name is treated as its own group.
An inner join to projects drops spatial records that have no matching project.

alternatives.interpretation: The ratio is the average of the per-record aream2/volm3 values within each funding source, not a ratio of totals.
